# `customer_pin`

Area: **security** ([all tables](README.md))

The account PIN of a customer (CPNI verification): hashed, set or reset by an agent with a recorded reason. No API returns it. Sensitive actions on a protected customer (a live prepaid product) need it in the X-Account-Pin header.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `pin_hash` | `text` | no |  | scrypt hash (the format of app_user.password_hash) of the 6 to 8 digit PIN; never logged or returned. |
| `set_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `set_by` | `text` | no |  | The operator who set or last reset it. |
| `reason` | `text` | no |  | Why it was set or reset (recorded by the agent). |
| `failed_attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` | Consecutive wrong PINs; a right one resets it, the lockout starts at the configured maximum. |
| `locked_until` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | While in the future, verification is refused even for the right PIN. |
